decisions.reason: The new notice explains the separate tip transaction but does not change when the mint-success modal appears, its token ID, or its random-referral action. The missing modal is an execution observation rather than a propagated value change.
The tipping notice does not change fiat buyers' dashboard, wallet, commission, ticket, prize, or reward-access behavior.
The source concerns a post-mint tip transaction and does not modify the Transak provider, fiat payment methods, conversion, or automatic fiat-mint flow.
The source does not change background wallet creation, custody, seed-phrase setup, key control, or any other fiat-wallet provisioning rule.
A notice identifying the separate tip transaction does not alter selection or disclosure of ETH and USDC mint-payment currencies.
The completed mint is runtime context, while the new UI notice does not change the NFT ebook product type or unlimited supply model.
The optional $1 tip and its explanatory notice do not change the $15 primary mint price or its no-hidden-fees pricing commitment.
The source does not change the USDC wallet-mint currency or expected NFT-mint outcome; the separate tip transaction is owned by the tipping Requirement.
An optional tip and its UI notice do not alter the fixed $15 primary-sale allocation among the founder, affiliate, and prize pool.
The source does not change ETH payment enablement, exact-output conversion, the 15 USDC swap target, or excess-refund behavior.
The tip-transaction notice does not change which mint payment methods are available or selectable.
The client requests a transaction-specific UI notice for tipping and does not require any change to the About page's project, payment, referral, prize, or reward-delivery copy.
